MAX_ACTIVATION_FEE_NUMERATOR().notice: Maximum numerator for the activation fee (3+ activations = 30% if minting fee).

activate(string).notice: Activates a name as the caller's primary name, configures forward/reverse resolver records The first activation per address is free; subsequent ones cost a fee

activations(address).notice: Number of activations done by an address.

available(string).notice: Returns whether a name can be registered. A name is available only if it is not blocked and the token is free or expired.

constructor.notice: Prevents initialization of the implementation contract.

getActivationFee(address).notice: Returns the fee an address must pay for its next activation. Fee scales 10% per prior activation, capped at 30% of the minting fee: 0 -> free, 1 -> 10%, 2 -> 20%, 3+ -> 30%.

getHashOfName(string).notice: Returns the label hash of a name.

isNameBlocked(string).notice: Returns whether a name is blocked.

mintingFee().notice: Current cost to register a name.

moderateName(address,string,string,strin.notice: Blocks a name and deactivates it if it is currently active.

namesReverse(bytes32).notice: Reverse index from a name's label hash to the address.

register(string).notice: Registers a `.dmd` name, minting its token to the caller.

reinsertPot().notice: Minting and activation fees collector address.

renew(string).notice: Extends the registration term of an owned name.

resetRecordsOnTransfer(address,uint256).notice: Resets the resolver records of a transferred name.

setMintingFee(uint256).notice: Updates the minting and token transfer fee.

setNameBlocked(string,bool).notice: Sets the blocked status of a name.

setNamesBlocked(string[],bool).notice: Sets the blocked status of multiple names.

valid(string).notice: Validate the name against the current rules.
